The magnetic field symbol “×” is drawn only in the annular region between ring P and ring Q, indicating that the direction of the magnetic field in this region is vertically downward; no magnetic field symbols are drawn in the region inside ring Q. Reasoning: Treat ring P and ring Q separately as closed circuits. No magnetic field passes through the area enclosed by ring Q, so the magnetic flux through ring Q does not change with time, and there is no induced current in ring Q. The area enclosed by ring P contains the annular magnetic-field region between P and Q, and this vertically downward magnetic field increases uniformly with time, so the downward magnetic flux through ring P increases. According to Lenz's law, the induced current in ring P should produce a vertically upward magnetic field to hinder the increase of the downward magnetic flux. By the right-hand rule, the direction of the current that produces a vertically upward magnetic field is counterclockwise.

method.method_draft: 分别把P、Q看作闭合回路，判断各自所围面积内的磁通量是否随时间变化。由图读出P是外环、Q是内环，磁场的叉号只分布在两环之间的环形区域，表示磁场竖直向下；由题文读出该磁场大小随时间均匀增强。Q环所围的内部区域没有磁场穿过，因此Q环磁通量不变，无感应电流。P环所围面积包含两环之间的磁场区域，穿过P环的向下磁通量增大。根据楞次定律，P环中的感应电流应产生竖直向上的磁场来阻碍向下磁通量的增加；用右手定则判断，产生向上磁场的电流方向为逆时针。因此只有P环有逆时针方向的感应电流。
